label: NOTE: seventeen functions of stores through two pointers, so almost every mutation moves an OFFSET, a CONSTANT or an ARM. The fixture is what makes them separable: four blocks filled from one pseudorandom seed and compared byte for byte afterwards, so a store one field high shows twice -- at the field that did not move and at the one that should not have. The relocated fields (the two constellation maps, the slicer, four Viterbi tables) are skipped by the byte comparison and checked per side against the symbol that side should hold, which is why a wrong-arm map is still caught.
the four-point arms pick the differential encoder where the object picks the absolute one
the coder's pad02 does not take the selector's value
14400 shifts by its six bits per symbol rather than by the scrambler's three-bit sub-group -- F8214's near-miss, made into a mutation
find: shift = 3;		/* six bits, sent as two groups of 3 */
replace: shift = 6;		/* six bits, sent as two groups of 3 */
